description: Behavior-preserving rewrite of the five-step asset downloader: the error-first callback pyramid in src/downloader.js becomes async/await with try/catch, downloadPipeline(url, opts) returns a Promise, and the acceptance gate pins the resolved values, the SAVED side effect and every exact rejection message before and after the change.

criteria: src/downloader.js is rewritten so every step is an async function, downloadPipeline(url, opts) awaits the chain inside try/catch and returns a Promise resolving with the saved record or rejecting with the first failure, no callback parameter or error-first hand-off remains anywhere in the file, and the acceptance gate pinning the resolved values, the opts.compact/opts.prefix handling, the SAVED side effect and all six exact rejection messages still exits 0.
